status_policy: No task statuses here; tasks/project.json is sole source of truth

additional_ac.text: Typed Mission/WorldState/Decision/Capability/Evidence/GenerationUnit contracts; versions/tenant links; no new unbounded tools.
Design shared versioned device/task/outcome contracts and production-shaped stack/migration; local SQLite preview not tenant ledger; concrete choices resolved before scaffold.
Recover persisted unit/attempt/envelope; unknown paid outcome reconciled without blind submit; pause drains/polls in-flight and denies new affected actions.
Durable server/device intent, pinned task, fencing/replay and suspend/reconnect design; lease expiry or lost acknowledgement never permits blind external resubmit.
Atomically enforce frozen unit B/R/C and ancestor caps including pending liabilities; operation/attempt changes do not reset limits; unknown invoices never zero.
Single authoritative paid ledger/reservation across runtimes and distinct research budget; offline/stale device balance cannot authorise new paid work; usage/invoice evidence separate.
Recovery card presents defect/evidence/changed repair/retained assets/price; auto and manual edit modes; approval single-use version/hash/attempt bound.
Preflight compiles only accepted adapter inputs; stage vs final fidelity distinguished; bounded own 2D route and typed future Blender/control target.
Manual pilot retained; delegated mode stays disabled until activation; targeted repairs preserve unaffected assets; two failures pause before third; reserve cannot override safety.
Declared lower/upper duration and narration completeness are checked independently of hash/codecs; partial output not silently accepted to satisfy cost cap.
Report all admitted units, first-generation vs first-delivery vs autonomous completion, human intervention/critical failure/all attempts costs and declared uncertainty.
Report actual accepted-result costs, repair/latency/interventions and unknown usage; no promised economic outcome from fixture prices/estimated rewards.
Per-function substitute and real final camera/continuity benchmark; exact Blender input does not certify generative final output; no closed-backend portability assumption.
Research/Dev sandbox separate from production; candidate→holdout→review→canary; protected tests/policy/budget cannot self-modify; new-model activation evidence.
Sanitised versioned cross-runtime ImprovementPackage requires destination compatibility/holdout/review/canary/rollback; scope-specific scenarios and seed exclusion; pilot does not accept full P6.
20% monetary repair preset requires explicit acceptance; strict >10% display vs authorized repair headroom; scope change excluded; third-attempt and beyond-cap repair approvals tested.
Architect supervises four existing roles under one dispatcher; independent code guards and QA uncertainty; no redundant mandatory calls/duplicate commands.
One canonical dispatcher and policy/budget semantics across adapters; roles do not duplicate calls or side effects; irreversible action auth enforced outside LLM.
Architect Factory adapter implemented as bounded contract before future shell; per-module scopes/private data/export independence; delegated publishing separate gate.

Specify detachable Companion contract, independent Factory availability, Windows10/11 first and Linux/macOS later; per-device/private scopes and compatibility; client implementation separately decomposed/gated, not full Personal shell.
Declare strict/adaptive duration and tolerance/full narration checks before eval; technical short-WAV fixtures are not fulfillment proof.
P0 spike evidence distinguishes media validity from requested duration/narration completion and estimate from actual usage/invoice; GAP-DURATION/GAP-COST not closed by docs.
Authoritative tenant/actor/device pairing and revocation design; no direct laptop DB secret or caller-success authority; connected/public client activation separately gated.
Scoped artifact transfer/private storage/quarantine/rights/retention; device local paths and fixture receipt never signed delivery authority; migration/restore tested.
Manual export retained; official API publication independently authorised and reconciled; Desktop/browser publication not prerequisite; standard single-account path before multiaccount.
Tool candidate commercialization needs IP/licence/privacy/security/support/release evidence; an internal useful script is not automatically a market-ready product.
Incremental authenticated working UI is distinguished from brief preview; actual responsive/a11y checks, no production claim from static screenshots.
One real project/job/result/edit/export vertical slice with persistent versions and visible cost/error states, not another detached brief mock; preserve existing accepted UX scope.
Web/staging E2E and novice evidence separated from mocks and OS runtime checks; exact tested targets/prototype limitations/transitions in handoff.
